Text:
[II] All children of God, together with all the holy women, let us proclaim our faith in our Savior and call upon Him together:
[IR] Come, Lord Jesus!
[I1] Lord Jesus, holy women faithfully followed You and stood by Your side, even past the moment of Your death,
[I2] help us to embody their devotion with faith and charity.
[I1] Lord Jesus, Your are the teacher who Mary listened to and Martha served,
[I2] invite us to learn from You, and to serve You.
[I1] Lord Jesus, You appeared to Mary, called her by name, and chose her to be the first to proclaim Your resurrection,
[I2] let us experience her joy as we proclaim that life overcomes death.
[I1] Lord Jesus, You call everyone who does Your will are Your sister, Your mother, and Your brother,
[I2] help us to walk in Your will, in Your love, and with Your grace.
Changes: 2026-07-17 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of these intentions.
